items.headline: Utah State scores 14 unanswered points after halftime to beat Washington State 17-16
items.description: — Grady Brosterhous threw for 150 yards and a touchdown, Javen Jacobs had 62 yards rushing and a score, and Utah State scored 14 unanswered points in the second half to beat Washington State 17-16 on Friday night.
